messages.subject: mirt - same factor loading
parts:
I have data sets with missing response. When I tried to analyze the data in mirt, I had the same factor loading for all the items in the same factor. It doesn't look right to me. Where did I go wrong? Here is an example:

EFA:
> model_F2
$x
     Type  Parameters
[1,] "F1"  "1-124"   
[2,] "F2"  "1-124"   
[3,] "COV" "F1*F2"   

> Result_Full2 = mirt(Data, model_F2, itemtype = "Rasch", method = 'QMCEM', quadpts = Num_Qpt, TOL = Tolerance)

> summary(Result_Full2) #part of the ourput
         F1    F2    h2
X1201 0.328 0.104 0.119
X1202 0.328 0.104 0.119
X1203 0.328 0.104 0.119
X1205 0.328 0.104 0.119
X1206 0.328 0.104 0.119
X1207 0.328 0.104 0.119
X1208 0.328 0.104 0.119
X1209 0.328 0.104 0.119


Unidimensional:

>AA = mirt(Data, 1, itemtype = "Rasch")
> summary(AA)
        F1    h2
X1201 0.43 0.185
X1202 0.43 0.185
X1203 0.43 0.185
X1205 0.43 0.185
X1206 0.43 0.185
X1207 0.43 0.185
X1208 0.43 0.185
X1209 0.43 0.185
X1210 0.43 0.185

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirt - same factor loading
parts:
You've specified the itemtype to be 'Rasch', which means that all the slopes are constrained to be 1, and only the latent variance terms are estimated. If you would like to allow for unequal correlations then select alternative itemtypes. Cheers.

Phil
